bi_triggers.name: uTRI_BI_EQUIPAMENTO
bi_triggers.definition:
CREATE   TRIGGER uTRI_BI_EQUIPAMENTO ON BI AFTER INSERT AS 
BEGIN 
	PRINT 'TRIGGER: uTRI_BI_EQUIPAMENTO'

	DECLARE @MATRICULA VARCHAR(40) 

	DECLARE crsTMP CURSOR LOCAL FAST_FORWARD FOR 
		SELECT TRIM(I.LOBS) FROM INSERTED AS I WHERE I.NDOS = 216 AND I.REF <> '' AND I.LOBS <> ''

	OPEN crsTMP
		FETCH NEXT FROM crsTMP INTO @MATRICULA

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			BEGIN 
				EXEC uSP_SET_EQUIPAMENTO @IN_MATRICULA = @MATRICULA

				FETCH NEXT FROM crsTMP INTO @MATRICULA
			END
	CLOSE crsTMP
	DEALLOCATE crsTMP 
END

BEGIN 
	PRINT 'TRIGGER: uTRU_BI_EQUIPAMENTO'

	OPEN crsTMP

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

				EXEC uSP_SET_EQUIPAMENTO @IN_MATRICULA = @MATRICULA

				FETCH NEXT FROM crsTMP INTO @MATRICULA
			END
	CLOSE crsTMP
	DEALLOCATE crsTMP 
END
